lines.en: Would you like to respond?
lines.zh: 要回复这条消息吗？

lines.en: What would you like to say?
lines.zh: 你想说点什么？

lines.en: : {i}Cool picture, Nodoka. I understand exactly what's going on and the emotions you're trying to convey.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}很棒的照片，Nodoka。我完全理解你想表达的东西和情感。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Do you know where I am right now, Sensei?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你知道我现在在哪儿吗，Sensei？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It looks like the hotel room.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}看起来是那间酒店房间。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}That is correct. It is the hotel room. And I am completely naked and wandering around as if I own the place.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}正确。就是那间酒店房间。而我正一丝不挂地四处晃悠，仿佛这地方是我的一样。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Is that an invitation? Or...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这是邀请吗？还是说……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I wonder if there is anything you could do for me that my little friend on the table could not?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我在想，有什么是你能为我做、而桌上那位小伙伴做不到的？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Well, for one, I can talk.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}首先，我会说话。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And what sort of things would you say?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那你会说些什么样的话？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I'm not really the type to reveal such specific information over the phone.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我不是那种会在电话里透露这么具体信息的人。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And I'm not the type to carelessly traipse around hotels in the nude.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我也不是那种会大大咧咧光着身子在酒店里乱晃的人。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}That is very obviously not true.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这显然不是真的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I'm also not the type to tell the truth 100%% of the time.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我也不是那种 100%% 说实话的人。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Sensei, what do you think would happen if I were to leave this room in my current state?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Sensei，你觉得如果我以现在这副样子走出这个房间，会发生什么？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You'd probably be arrested. Or sexually harrassed and/or assaulted if you encountered any males. Which seems unlikely, but still.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你大概会被逮捕。或者如果遇到男性，会被性骚扰和/或性侵。虽然看起来不太可能，但还是有可能。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And if I encountered you?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那如果遇到你呢？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You're really gunning for cybersex right now, aren't you?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你现在是真的在拼命想要网络性爱，对吧？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You're the only one I'd spread the lips of my intangible Internet pussy for. I just want you to know that.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你是我唯一愿意为它张开那看不见的网络小穴的嘴唇的人。我只想让你知道这一点。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}That is probably the second strangest text I have ever gotten.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这大概是我收到过第二奇怪的短信了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Interesting. The first being?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}有意思。第一是？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}The picture that sparked this entire conversation.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}就是引发这整段对话的那张照片。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Understandable. Arousal does have a tendency to spark creative genius in me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}可以理解。性唤起确实容易在我身上激发创作才华。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}But alas, our conversation must end here as the rest of the girls have shown up and don't particularly care for my lack of attire.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}唉，可惜我们的对话得在这里结束了——其他女孩都来了，而且她们不太欣赏我这身打扮。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Adieu, Sensei. I will be thinking of you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}再会，Sensei。我会想着你的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I don't even know where to start with that picture.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那张照片我都不知道该从哪儿说起。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}The wonderful thing about art is that a great deal of it can be interpreted in whichever way its audience desires.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}艺术的妙处在于，其中很大一部分任由观众随意解读。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}When you look at that image, what is the first thing you notice?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你看着那张图的时候，第一眼注意到的是什么？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}That you are naked.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你没穿衣服。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Indeed I am.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}确实没穿。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I am entirely nude and staring directly at the camera. Staring directly at you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我一丝不挂，直勾勾地盯着镜头。直勾勾地盯着你。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And yet, an array of objects fill the gap between us. Preventing you from seeing the one thing you want to see.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}然而，一堆物件填满了我们之间的空隙。让你看不见你唯一想看的那件东西。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Preventing me from getting through to you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}也让我没办法触碰到你。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Do you see the picture any differently now?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}现在你对这张照片的看法有不同了吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Not really. I'm still just imagining what you look like behind the pineapple and...knife. And dildo. {/i}
lines.zh: : {i}没什么不同。我还是在想象菠萝和……刀。还有按摩棒后面你是什么样子。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And...is that one of those evidence signs they use in crime scenes?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}还有……那是犯罪现场用的那种物证牌吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}If that's what you want it to be.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}如果你想让它是什么，它就是什么。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}The important part is that it is an obstacle.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}重要的是，它是一个障碍物。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}The picture mimics our reality.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这张照片在模仿我们的现实。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}There are many strange or curious things keeping the two of us apart.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}有太多奇怪或奇妙的东西把我们俩隔开。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And you will never get what you want until you figure out how to get rid of them.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}而你永远得不到你想要的，直到你弄明白该怎么把它们弄走。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Just fucking move them and take a new picture.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}直接他妈的把它们挪开重拍一张不就完了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I can't :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我做不到 :){/i}

lines.en: : {i}Why are you hugging a pineapple?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你为什么抱着个菠萝？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Obviously because I intend to have sex with it.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}显然是因为我打算跟它做爱。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}There is a perfectly good dildo on the table. And a perfectly good penis on the phone with you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}桌上就有一根好好的按摩棒。而且电话这头还有一个好好的阴茎陪着你。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I had no idea you were so talented. Texting with a penis sounds rather difficult.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我还不知道你这么有才。用阴茎发短信听起来挺难的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You know what I mean.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你懂我意思。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I do. And, though it pains me to say this as it reveals I am a liar, I am not actually going to have sex with this pineapple tonight.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我懂。而且，虽然说出来等于承认我是个骗子、让我很痛心——但我今晚其实不会跟这个菠萝做爱。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Waiting until the two of you are married.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}等到你们俩结婚的时候。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}No. It's simply not ripe enough.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不是。只是它还不够熟。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You and I are very similar creatures, Sensei. But there is one glaring difference between the two of us.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你和我是非常相似的生物，Sensei。但我们之间有一个明显的区别。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You see, I like my fruit ripe. You like yours...green.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你看，我喜欢我的果子熟的。而你喜欢你的……青的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Blooming, even.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}甚至还是含苞待放的那种。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And I like that about you. For I, too, am green.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}而我喜欢你这一点。因为我也一样，是青的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Hell of a tangent for me just trying to talk about fruit.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我只是想聊聊水果，居然扯了这么远。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I'm talking about fruit too ;){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我也在聊水果啊 ;){/i}

lines.en: : {i}There's a peach in that very image with your name written all over it.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那张照片里就有一只桃子，简直就是为你准备的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Won't you come eat it? It's unripe...just the way you like it.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你不过来吃吗？它还没熟……正合你的口味。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I see no peach, Nodoka.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我没看到什么桃子，Nodoka。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Then you aren't looking hard enough :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那是你没看仔细 :){/i}
